method: Photographs only -> fixed observations plus condition and facility summaries. Six real API batches, two candidates each. Twelve model calls total. Synthetic lot descriptions and 950kg; actual research photos. No receiving company participation.

source.image_preparation: Split Figure 6.1 left/right photo bounds, rendered at 3x, RGB JPEG quality82 as production. No dirt synthesis or retouch. Captions and filenames not sent.

limitations: Only one paired source (two photographs), not an accuracy dataset.
No external expert adjudication or facility intake threshold ground truth.
Washed does not prove pure/safe; unknown facts remain unknown.
Independent observations can vary across repeated calls; input separation removes the declaration from the observer but does not eliminate visual hallucination.
Photographs retained locally and not redistributed.
This evaluation exercises the intake API; browser/QR workflows were not repeated here.
